scope: Compare the accepted RUN-A and RUN-B attempts for L1-A18.
static_analysis: COMPARISON reads the accepted usable attempt of RUN-A and the accepted usable attempt of RUN-B, and the complete attempt history of both. Superseded attempts are reported, not filtered: a comparison that shows only the attempts that worked is not a record of what happened. It refuses to run at all unless both phases have an accepted usable sealed attempt.

steps.purpose: Read the accepted attempt pointer and the full attempt history for RUN-A and RUN-B.
Bind the comparison to the attempt history it read.

target.identity_evidence: the same target both runs were bound to; a comparison across two different targets compares nothing

compared: the reason recorded for every disagreement

test_matrix.refusal: COMPARISON refuses unless both RUN-A and RUN-B have an accepted usable sealed attempt

test_matrix.disagreement: a disagreement between the two methods is a finding in its own right and is never resolved by preferring the run that matches expectation
